text.text: Containers can be used to group together other components and apply a common layout or style.

text_1020056342.text: Container attributes and style system offer authors the flexibility to achieve more complex layouts and designs.

text.text:
Background Color:

Allows you to choose a pre-defined solid color background for the container. 

For accessibility purposes use colors that provide adequate contrast with the text.

Background Image:

Background image for the container. The image will fill 100% of the container per the selected style.

Note: for accessibility purposes use images that provide adequate contrast with the text.
This is a default container with a color background applied.
This is a default container with an overlap style. Overlap adds negative margin to the top of the container causing the container to overlap with the previous container.
This is a default container with a homepage overlap style. Home page overlap has more negative margin than the overlap style.

Desktop Width Styles:

The following containers will illustrate the different desktop widths available. In addition, a short height will also be applied.
Full desktop width style

text_674589139.text:
Transparency Styles:

Transparencies with an image background. Semi-Transparent applies an AbbVie dark blue transparency over the background. The linear gradient applies a black linear gradient over the background.

text_632631724.text:
Radius Styles:

Radius style applies a rounded corner to the top left of the container. Default is no rounded corner. Radius' are typically used on call out containers, with picture backgrounds and on the toasters.
